verdict.rationale: Quo documents its own call-routing features: routing incoming calls to the right person, custom ring orders, call transfers and phone menus. Its apps also run on iOS and Android, so the business line can be reached on a cell. None of the evidence explicitly shows forwarding the business number to an external cell number, or forwarding triggered when the team is away from the desk. missing for 10: explicit documentation of forwarding to an external/cell number, away-from-desk or business-hours conditional forwarding, setup steps, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forward the business number to a cell when the team is away from the desk

citations.quote: Route incoming calls to the right person instantly
